reading.zh: 按设置面板的页签顺序（Gameplay → Keybind → Graphics → Audio，与 SettingCategory 枚举一致）排列；按键绑定二级页由按键页进入，排在最后。
reading.en: Ordered by the panel tab order (Gameplay → Keybind → Graphics → Audio, matching the SettingCategory enum); the keybind-bindings second-level page is reached from the keybind page and sits last.
